title: Chatbot: a reloaded answer draws a redrawn chart twice, because the history reader keeps every visualize_data result instead of the last per chartId
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ④ the framework half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4824 (p1, re-verification of p1 cloud#4796/#4797/#4798 under objectstack#34571), found by the cloud#4824 card thread (os-dev-report objectstack-ai/cloud#4824 comment 6942521456, out-of-scope finding, `carrier: objectstack`). Blocks: the reload half of objectstack-ai/cloud#4824 acceptance 1 (「回答里只有一张图」).

## 维护者速读

问数一次回答里模型重画了一张图时，cloud#4826 让实时对话只剩最后一张（同一个 `data-chart` 部件 id 原位替换）。但刷新页面、从历史重载这段对话时，控制台从每次 `visualize_data` 的结果重建图表，被替换掉的那张又回来了，用户又看到两张图。cloud 现在给每个结果写了 `chartId`：被替换的那张和替换它的那张 id 相同。平台的历史读取只要在同一条消息里按 `chartId` 留最后一张即可。

## Facts (objectstack `b1da9f55db`, cloud PR #4826 head `0e9b21c`)

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/toolResultParsers.ts` `extractCharts` (around line 156): a message with no `data-chart` part (server history: the streamed part is transient and never stored) reads its charts from every `visualize_data` result through `chartFromToolResult` (around line 222) and draws each one.
- A live stream is fine: the AI SDK client reducer folds `data-chart` parts with the same id in place, so `fromParts` holds one chart.
- Cloud PR #4826 (`visualize_data` with `replacesPrevious`) writes `chartId` at the top level of each `visualize_data` result envelope, beside `chart`. A replacing result carries the same `chartId` as the chart it replaced. A result without `chartId` (older history, other producers) is unchanged.

## Work

1. In `extractCharts`, on the results path only: when two or more `visualize_data` results in ONE message carry the same `chartId`, keep the last one, at the text offset of the FIRST (where the user first saw the chart). Results without `chartId` are kept as today.
2. Dedupe only within one message, never across messages. `chartId` is unique within one request, not across requests, process restarts or replicas.
3. The `data-chart` part path is unchanged.

## Acceptance

- Tests: two results with the same `chartId` in one message give one chart, the last result's descriptor at the first result's offset. Two results with different `chartId` give two charts. Results without `chartId` behave byte for byte as today (CONTROL). The same `chartId` in two different messages gives one chart in each.
- No change to the live stream path.

## Not in scope

Cloud's `replacesPrevious` and `chartId` (cloud#4824, PR #4826). The 「（非指标口径）」 label (cloud#4824 item 2, a pending ruling).

Dedup words: extractCharts chartId reload two charts; visualize_data persisted chart superseded; toolResultParsers chartFromToolResult.
